name: Equinix KL1 & KL2 data centres, Cyberjaya
status_detail: KL1 operational (May 2024, Phase 2 completed May 2025); KL2 announced May 2026, in planning
summary: Equinix's first Kuala Lumpur data centre (KL1) is an IBX facility in Cyberjaya that launched in May 2024 with a total investment of approximately US$100 million and 900-cabinet capacity after Phase 2 completion in May 2025. A second purpose-built facility, KL2, was announced in May 2026 with a US$190 million investment delivering 2,200+ cabinets, located less than 1 km from KL1.

scale.label: Scope
scale.value: Two interconnected IBX facilities in Cyberjaya; Equinix's 3rd and 4th Malaysia DCs

why_it_matters: Equinix brings its global interconnection platform to the Klang Valley, positioning Cyberjaya as a neutral meeting point for network providers, cloud platforms and enterprises. KL2's rapid follow-on signals strong commercial traction among businesses building distributed architectures spanning KL, Johor and Singapore.
questions_to_follow: When does KL2 construction begin and what is the target operational date?
How many cloud on-ramps and network providers are live at KL1?
location_precision: KL1 is at Jalan Cyber Point 4, Cyber 8, Cyberjaya. KL2 is on a 14,300 sqm plot acquired in July 2024, less than 1 km from KL1. Coordinates are area-level for the Cyber 8 precinct.

sources.title: Equinix to Develop Purpose-Built IBX Data Center in Kuala Lumpur to Support Malaysia's AI and Cloud Growth
US firm Equinix completes second phase of data centre in Cyberjaya

history.event: Equinix KL1 launches in Cyberjaya alongside JH1 in Johor, marking entry into Malaysia.
Equinix acquires 14,300 sqm land in Cyberjaya for RM23 million for the planned KL2 facility.
KL1 Phase 2 completed, bringing total capacity to 900 cabinets and 2.4 MVA power load.
Equinix announces KL2 with a US$190 million investment for 2,200+ cabinets.
